content:
{'text': '俄亥俄州民主黨眾議員喬伊斯·比蒂週二詳細描述了她與總統唐納德·特朗普之間的一次激烈交鋒，此前特朗普在一場將其姓名加在甘迺迪中心上的法律戰中敗訴。比蒂表示，特朗普當時陷入一場「暴躁發飆」，她隨即當面質問他。', 'tr': 'Ohio Democratic Rep. Joyce Beatty detailed Tuesday a heated exchange she had with President Donald Trump, after Trump lost a legal battle to put his name on the Kennedy Center. Beatty said Trump was in a "temper tantrum," and she confronted him to his face.'}

{'text': '比蒂週二晚間在MSN NOW節目《The Weeknight》播出時表示：「我的意思是，讓我簡單說清楚。這是我親眼目睹或親身參與過的最不專業的事情。」', 'tr': '"I mean, let me just be clear. This was the most unprofessional thing that I have ever witnessed or been a part of," Beatty said Tuesday night on MS NOW\'s "The Weeknight."'}

{'text': '這位民主黨人繼續說道：「他開始罵人，從說我是阻撓者，到說我愚蠢，什麼都罵。」她說：「他說：『我覺得你很無能。』我回他：『我知道你很無能。』」', 'tr': 'The Democrat continued: "He started calling names, from me being an obstructionist to me being stupid, name-calling." She said: "He said, \'I think you\'re incompetent.\' I said, \'I know you\'re incompetent.\'"'}

{'text': '比蒂說：「我不會讓他用那些難聽的話罵我。」', 'tr': '"I\'m not going to let him call me out of my name," Beatty said.'}

{'text': '這位俄亥俄州議員由國會委派擔任甘迺迪中心信託委員會成員。她告訴MSN NOW節目主持人，特朗普週二在一場有關場館維修工程的網上委員會會議上向她發起攻擊。特朗普已表明，除非紀念已故總統約翰·F·甘迺迪的場館冠上他的名字，否則維修工程不會進行。', 'tr': "The Ohio lawmaker is a member of the Kennedy Center's Board of Trustees by congressional appointment. She told the MS NOW host that Trump attacked her during a virtual committee meeting Tuesday about renovations at the venue. Trump has made clear that renovations won't happen unless the venue honoring the late President John F. Kennedy carries his name."}

{'text': '比蒂告訴MSN NOW節目主持人：「他說如果天花板塌下來砸死人，他要我承擔責任。我當時回他說：『你已經在殺人了。我們正處於戰爭之中，還有人在捱餓。你卻在搞這些事。』」', 'tr': '"He said if the ceiling falls and kills someone, he wants me to take the responsibility," Beatty told the MS NOW host. "And I said to him, \'You\'re already killing people. We\'re at war and people are starving. And you\'re doing this.\'"'}

{'text': '她補充道：「然後他還想吹噓自己多麼了不起，說對我毫不了解，但我從沒做過什麼事，這是我做過的最大的一件事。於是我提醒他，在座所有人當中他破產的次數最多。」', 'tr': 'She added: "And then he wanted to brag about how wonderful he is, and that he doesn\'t know me, and I\'ve never done anything, and this is the biggest thing I\'ve done. So I reminded him that he\'s bankrupted more times than anybody in the room."'}

{'text': '請觀看以下比蒂描述特朗普「暴躁發飆」的片段：', 'tr': 'Watch Beatty describe Trump\'s "temper tantrum" in the clip below:'}

{'text': '白宮在回應《HuffPost》的一份聲明中聲稱：「幾十年來，民主黨任由甘迺迪中心敗壞，漏水問題蔓延、基建設施崩潰，國寶在他們眼皮底下四分五裂。」聲明還表示，特朗普將「修復甘迺迪中心，將其打造成全球最頂尖的表演藝術場地」。', 'tr': 'The White House claimed in a statement to HuffPost that "Democrats have let the Kennedy Center deteriorate for decades, leaking water, crumbling infrastructure, and a national treasure falling apart right before their eyes." The statement also said Trump will "restore the Kennedy Center and make it the preeminent performing arts venue in the world."'}

{'text': '自甘迺迪中心1971年開幕以來，已有四名民主黨人和六名共和黨人——包括特朗普在其首個任期內——曾在該中心任職。', 'tr': 'Four Democrats and six Republicans ― including Trump during his first term ― have served on the Kennedy Center since it opened in 1971.'}

{'text': '如今已充斥總統盟友的甘迺迪中心董事會週二投票決定關閉場館。特朗普在Truth Social發文稱，董事會「幾乎一致」投票「立即」關閉中心，並聲稱中心處於「實際崩塌狀態」。', 'tr': 'The Kennedy Center\'s board of trustees, now stocked with the president\'s allies, voted to close the venue on Tuesday. Trump posted on Truth Social that the board "nearly unanimously" voted to close the center "immediately" and claimed the venue is in a state of "virtual collapse."'}

{'text': '但在接受CNN記者凱特蘭·柯林斯的另一場訪問時，比蒂反駁了總統所謂中心將立即關閉的說法。這位議員表示，她並未投票贊成關閉中心，其他董事會成員「也沒有投票支持他在Truth Social上張貼的那種措辭」。', 'tr': 'But in a separate interview with CNN\'s Kaitlan Collins, Beatty pushed back on the president\'s claim that the center would be closed immediately. The lawmaker said she did not vote to close the center, and other board members "didn\'t vote for the kind of language that he posted on Truth Social either."'}

{'text': '請觀看以下比蒂與凱特蘭·柯林斯的對話片段：', 'tr': "Watch Beatty's conversation with Kaitlan Collins in the clip below:"}

{'text': '比蒂告訴柯林斯，她認為特朗普週二在與她的通話中「把事情鬧成針對個人」，因為她是阻止他為中心更名那場官司的聯署人之一。她說：「他挑錯了人。」', 'tr': 'Beatty told Collins she thinks Trump "took it personally" during his call with her Tuesday because she was one of the co-signers of the lawsuit that stopped him from renaming the center. "He picked the wrong person," she said.'}

{'text': '比蒂說：「我認為任何人聽到一位總統使用那樣的措辭都會覺得不可思議。他大發脾氣，就像個不成熟的孩子。我甚至不想把這種行為套在孩子身上。就是非常——在我看來——非常幼稚、大喊大叫、罵人。」', 'tr': '"I think anyone who would hear a president use that kind of language, it\'s just unthinkable," Beatty said. "He threw a fit, like an immature child. I don\'t want to put that on a child. It\'s just very ― in my mind ― very childish, yelling and screaming, name-calling."'}

{'text': '這位議員說：「我感到失望，但我不會讓他用霸凌的手段欺負我，因為他就是這樣的人。他想恐嚇別人。」她說：「他想霸凌別人，因為他沒能如願，因為他想將這件事變成他的面子工程。」', 'tr': '"I am disappointed, but I\'m not going to let him bully me, because that\'s who he is. He wants to intimidate people," the lawmaker said. "He wants to bully people because he didn\'t get his way, because he wants to make this his legacy project."'}
